{{Quote|I've been to Tynna. It's one of the most beautiful worlds in the Expansion Region. And the Tynnans are probably one of the most well-informed and well-intentioned species anywhere.|[[Belindi Kalenda]]|<ref name="AoCII:JE" />}}
'''Tynna''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tynnani system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnans]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]]. A member world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], Tynna defected to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and later repelled [[Invasion of Tynna|an invasion]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During its membership of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Tynna was [[Battle of Tynna|captured]] by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and its environment [[Terraforming/Legends|modified]] to serve the invaders as a biological production center. Subsequently a part of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], Tynna later came under the sway of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
Tynna was situated on the [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Tynnani system]]<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]'s [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a frigid<ref name="NJOSB89" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that featured [[Water/Legends|lakes]] and [[Forest/Legends|forests]].<ref name="TEA" /> A key business partner of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]],<ref name="NJOSB89" /> it was a wealthy, state-run world whose inhabitants were not required to work.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>

==History==
Tynna was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until a [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mite]] infestation in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] prompted its leader [[Razelfiin]] to call for secession shortly before the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN53153" /> While Tynna resultantly joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the planet returned to the Republic prior to the end of the war, with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Streamdrinker/Legends|Streamdrinker]] serving in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] until his [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrest]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ImperialHNN">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], it was the site of the failed [[Invasion of Tynna]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

During the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] considered basing themselves on Tynna, but chose [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] instead.<ref name="Insider92">{{InsiderCite|92|Refresher Reading}}</ref> The world was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] stronghold during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|Zsinj]] and [[Thrawn campaign]]s.<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Tynna was [[Battle of Tynna|conquered]] by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]],<ref name="AoCII:JE" /> who bio-engineered the planet's extensive seas for their own purposes. Remaining under Yuuzhan Vong control until the end of the war in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Tynna was situated in [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] space during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], and was a member state of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] as of [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
[[File:Tyn.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A Tynnan]]
The aquatic [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] Tynnans were indigenous to Tynna. The [[Tynnan government]] was lottery-run, with governmental positions being randomly awarded to average citizens; Tynnans kept informed of important issues in case they were selected. Negotiations with the Old Republic yielded serious investment from its corporations, with the Tynnans reinvesting the resultant profits back into their society. As such, the Tynnan economy was one of the most wealthy in the Republic. Basic provisions such as education, entertainment, [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and housing were provided for each citizen free of charge, and work was entirely optional; some Tynnans eschewed a career entirely and spent their lives as tourists.<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" /> However, if chosen by lottery, a Tynnan was obligated to serve in the position dictated, and fleeing Tynna was the only option if the individual did not so desire.<ref name="J15" />

==Locations==
[[File:Tanallay Surge complex.png|thumb|left|200px|The Tanallay Surge complex]]
[[Lutris]] was the site of [[Lutris Lake]], as well as the [[Tynna Central Government Building]] until its destruction by way of a stone mite outbreak in 22 BBY.<ref name="HNN53153" /> Another governmental institution was the [[Tanallay Surge complex]],<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" /> which contained a [[Tanallay Surge posting agency|posting agency]] for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="BoFettCode" /> Other locations included [[Water Park]], a major residential area featuring a number of dwellings, and the [[Business District (Tynna)|Business District]].<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tynna was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', which was written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1979]].<ref name="HanSoloRev">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref>
